variants.prompt: REFORMED SCENE/SETTING: Amidst the plush opulence of a penthouse suite, the raven-haired beauty reclines on a velvet chaise, her vintage lace dress hiked up to reveal long, toned legs crossed seductively. A champagne flute rests on a nearby side table, alongside a half-empty bottle of Veuve Clicquot. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame a stunning cityscape at dusk, the sky ablaze with hues of orange and pink. A single candle flickers on a nearby console, casting a warm glow on her alabaster skin as she gazes out at the breathtaking view, her emerald eyes seeming to hold a world of mystery.
